# Phase 5: offline map (synthetic tiles generated by tools/tiles/make_tiles.py --synthetic).
name Raphaël
time 1793541600
contact Bob 1 fav pos 43.6120 1.3420
contact Alice 2 pos 43.6085 1.3300

# --- Without tiles: grid, markers, notice; nothing read from the card
key k
expect-screen Carte
shot 50_map_no_tiles
expect-tiles-read 0
key `

# --- With tiles: centred on the tile set before the GPS fix
tiles build/maptiles
key k
shot 51_map_default_view
gps fix 9
pos 43.6116 1.3346
gps fix 9
wait 1500
shot 52_map_gps
# zoom in / out, pan, back to my position
key =
shot 53_map_zoom_in
key -*2
shot 54_map_zoom_out
key /
key .
shot 55_map_panned
key 0
shot 56_map_recentred

# --- The clock alone does not re-read the tiles
key =
wait 100
tiles build/maptiles
expect-tiles-read 0
wait 5000
expect-tiles-read 0
